(1) Pregnancy    (2) Heart disease    (3) High blood pressure    (4) Feeling unwell
SCENE1NOTICE: Complete hazard identification before entering the work area.
SCENE2NOTICE: Look around carefully and find where dust may be produced. When you find one, select it with your controller.
SCENE2COMPLETENOTICE: Well done. All dust sources have been identified.
SCENE4NOTICE: Based on the dust risk of this grinding task, choose a suitable respirator from the shelf.
SCENE4MISTAKE: Insufficient protection. This cannot effectively reduce the risk of inhaling dust.
SCENE4CORRECT: Correct choice. This respirator effectively blocks grinding dust. Next, please put it on.
SCENE4COMPLETE: Fitting complete. Please return to the grinding area.
SCENE6NOTICE: Cause of incident: The N95 mask was not properly sealed. Airborne particles from the fire smoke entered the airways through the gap between the mask and the face, causing smoke inhalation injury.
SCENE7NOSENOTICE: Complete the positive / negative pressure seal check.
SCENE7MOUTHNOTICE: A respirator is your last line of defense. Always put it on correctly before grinding.
SCECE7BoardSubcontent_1: Pick the protection level that matches the dust hazard
SCECE7BoardSubcontent_2: Facepiece sits snugly and straps are adjusted
SCECE7BoardSubcontent_3: Do a seal check every time you put it on
N95_NOTICE: Filters non-oil dust and fine particles. Suitable for general dry metal grinding.
HALF_MASK_NOTICE: Protects against gases/vapors. Without a particulate filter, it cannot effectively filter dust.
NORMAL_MASK_NOTICE: Protects against general odors only. Does not provide enough dust protection.
SAFE_GLASS_MASK_NOTICE: Reduces the risk of eye injury from dust and flying debris.
GRIND_TOOL_NOTICE: Pick up the tool to start grinding.
GRIND_TOOL_RENOTICE: Pick up the tool again to grind.
MASK_CHECK_NOTICE: Tap to confirm the mask seal points.
HEAD_MASK_CHECK_NOTICE: Tap to confirm the mask seal points
